strategy.summary: Reproduce the array_mean float32/complex64 precision bug (issue #10647, PR #10649) on buggy commit c50e90de by building Numba and running test_array_reductions::test_mean_count_rounding, which must fail because Numba divides by float32(a.size) (rounds 2**24+1 to 2**24) instead of dtype.type(c / a.size).

input_output_examples.buggy_output: Numba result differs from NumPy (float32 case: 0.9999999403953552)
input_output_examples.expected_output: assertPreciseEqual(npr, nbr) passes; Numba result equals NumPy (float32 case: 0.9999998807907104)

input_output_examples.expected_output: Matches CPython 3.14+ _Py_c_prod() NaN-recovery result (recovered infinities, not nan+nanj)

Reproduce by installing this buggy commit under Python 3.11 and running the PR's new test_pow_precision (or an equivalent inline njit script), observing the AssertionError.
